description: This Java class 'NottableSchemaString' extends 'NottableString' and provides functionality for handling JSON schema strings, including validation, parsing, and matching against JSON data. It utilizes Jackson for JSON processing, supports schema validation, and handles date/time formatting.

classes.name: NottableSchemaString
classes.description: A class for handling JSON schema strings with validation and matching capabilities, supporting 'not' logic and schema parsing.

methods.name: convertToJsonNode
methods.description: Converts a string value to a JsonNode based on its type and format, handling nulls, date-time, string, number, and integer types.

methods.name: getSchemaJsonNode
methods.description: Parses a JSON schema string into an ObjectNode, removing embedded 'not' fields, with error logging.

methods.name: schemaString
methods.description: Static factory method to create a NottableSchemaString with a value and optional 'not' flag.

methods.name: notSchema
methods.description: Static factory method to create a NottableSchemaString with 'not' set to true.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if the JSON string matches the schema, considering 'not' logic and validation errors.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a JSON string against the schema, considering nullability and using JsonSchemaValidator.
